name: io.github.flowinfosystems-index/abe
title: Abe
description: Free, local check before an AI agent acts: your rules return ACT, BLOCK or ESCALATE.

environmentVariables.name: ABE_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to your abe-policy.yaml (create one with: uvx abe-ai init)

environmentVariables.name: ABE_RESOLVER
environmentVariables.description: Set to flow to send escalations to Flow (needs FLOW_API_KEY). Default: none, nothing leaves your machine.

environmentVariables.name: FLOW_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Flow Resolver key (fjp_live_...), only with ABE_RESOLVER=flow. https://fjp.flowinfo.co/credits
